3376500.name: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
3376500.detailed_description:
Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a short game where you experiment in the kitchen.

You can drag, toss, and combine ingredients in fun and surprising ways, to fill your cookbook with over 300 recipes, ranging from the gourmet to the gross. The game is about 3 hours long.

KITCHEN SANDBOX

Get messy in the kitchen! Everything has weight, motion and personality. Drag and drop items, or throw them around. So, mix and match, toss and break things to complete your to do list. 

COUNTLESS SECRETS

Not all ingredients are easy to find. Every cabinet and shelf is chock-full of hidden ingredients waiting to be uncovered. Some are hidden, others are locked away, and solving these puzzles might mean thinking creatively.

CHAOTIC ACHIEVEMENTS

Behind every kitchen nook and cranny are achievements that reward you for bending the rules of the kitchen. To solve the game’s most challenging puzzles, players will need to throw out the recipe book, roll up their sleeves, and think outside the box.

FEATURES:

  • Around 3 hour of playtime to complete all 3 levels in 3 different kitchens.

  • Cook everything from comfort foods and gourmet dishes to strange, surprising experiments.

  • Play with satisfying physics as every ingredient and object reacts in fun, surprising ways.

  • Solve playful kitchen puzzles to uncover hidden ingredients, secrets, and new ways to cook.

  • Collect fun achievements that reward curiosity, chaos, and breaking the rules.

  • Follow a heartfelt story by unlocking each recipe.

THE TEAM

Hello! We are a small group of friends who wanted to make a cute game about cooking. We started this project in the end of 2024 and this will be is our first commercial release!

Our team is Julien (game designer & co-creator), Erika (artist & co-creator), Danny (programmer) and Kristin (narrative desiger) and Tumult Kollective (audio design).

Most of us work on this project part time but we love experimenting, learning, and pushing their ideas as far as their own skills, time, and personal investment allow us. And we hope you will enjoy our creation :)

3376990.name: Kabuto Park
3376990.detailed_description:
Kabuto Park is a cute and short bug collection game. Spend a month as Hana, a little girl on summer vacation. Catch the best bugs and level them up, choose your team carefully and fight other kids to become the Summer Beetle Battles champion.

Expect 2 to 4 hours of serene bug catching, exciting little battles and summer vibes.

Catch cute bugs 🦋✨

Beetles! Butterflies! Bees! Dragonflies! And many more! Discover more than 40 cool bug species that live in Kabuto Park and try to catch them by timing your net swings right.

Win the tiniest sumo fights 💪🪲

Choose your team depending on their stats, abilities or look and show other kids who the best beetle battler is! Each bug you select for your team will add cards to your deck that you'll be able to use during the little fights. Try to push your opponents out of the ring.

Your rhino beetle is not strong enough? Feed it candies to level it up and you'll have better luck winning the next fight!

Buy cool stuff 🔍📗

Better boots or a better net will surely make you the best bug catcher! Lucky for you, the local store has everything you need to get access to new areas with new bugs, make rare bugs appear more often or make capture easier.

Features 🎮

🪲 What Kabuto Park offers:

  • A short creature collector: With 2 to 4 hours of playtime, this game is a perfect snack for an afternoon or a few sessions here and there. I like to keep my game short, to the point and respectful of players' time.

  • Simple game mechanics: A relaxing capture mini game, little bug battles with a simple deck building gameplay, a light upgrade system and a leveling system to upgrade your favorite critters.

  • A cozy mood: Summer vibes, childlike wonder, cute art and lovely music!

  • The cutest bugs: Bugs from all around the world are here and ready to become your friend. You can even pet them in your terrarium!

🐞 What Kabuto Park does NOT offer:

  • No Exploration or moving around in the world.

  • No big adventure with quests and a long plot.

  • No multiplayer of any kind. No PVP, no trading.

  • No spiders. That one is for you arachnophobes.

Dev team 🐛🐞

Hey, I'm Doot and I'm back with Zakku for another tiny game ✨

We are the developer and music composer of Minami Lane and Froggy's Battle, still on our quest to bring more tiny cute games to the world! Trained and helped by Minami Lane's artist Blibloop, I made the art by myself this time (please don't be mean I'm trying my best).

We really hope you'll enjoy our little game 💖

3483740.name: Cast n Chill
3483740.detailed_description:
Cast n Chill's a laid-back fishin’ game for folks who’d rather wet a line than break a sweat. Whether yer driftin’ on a lazy lake, pokin’ 'round a winding river, or droppin’ lines in salty blue water, this here’s a game where you set the pace.

Upgrade Yer Gear

Start with the basics, catch whatever bites, sell your haul, and put those coins toward better rods, reels, and upgrades. Before ya know it, you’ll be wranglin’ rare species that’d make any angler green with envy.

Explore New Waters

Find yer favourite fishin’ hole or keep wanderin’. There’s 16 peaceful spots to discover, each with its own critters swimmin’ 'round, just waitin’ to bite.

Pick Your Pace

In Active Mode, you’re in the thick of it - castin’, reelin’, and keepin’ busy like a loon at nesting time.

Switch to Passive Mode if you’d rather let the game do the work while you’re off choppin’ wood.

Set it up on a second monitor or tuck it in the corner - come back later and see what kind o’ haul the fish gods left ya.

Collect 'Em All

There’s 50+ fish to discover - some you’ll recognize, some you’ll squint at and go “what in the heck is that?” From scrappy little sunfish to big ol’ deepwater beasts, they’re all in the logbook waitin’ for your name.

Legendary Catches

There’s 16 fish out there that still get folks jabberin’ at ol' Rusty's bait shop like they saw Bigfoot ride a moose. Land one, and you'll be part o' the legend.

Boat Buddies

Grab your rod and call a buddy, Cast 'n Chill now has co-op! Whether you’re lookin’ to kick back and fish side-by-side or stir up a bit of friendly competition, it’s all better with company.

Trusty Companion

Nothin’ beats a day on the lake with a four-legged friend. They might not know a spinnerbait from a spoon, but they’ll help you spot a fish - if only 'cause they’re hopin’ for a bite themselves.

Restore Your Very Own Fishing Cabin

Roll up your sleeves and bring a worn down lakeside shack back to life, then kick back and enjoy the quiet while fishin’ off your own dock. Stock your pond, mount replicas of your best catches, and settle in while your trusty companion curls up by the fire.

3527020.name: Shut the windows and don't look outside
3527020.detailed_description:
Gameplay

Survive:

You are alone, trapped in your own home, waiting for "help" to arrive. To make it through the night, you must keep your fear in check and ensure no unwelcome presence lingers for too long. Every second in the dark brings you closer to the unknown.

Manage:

Your home is your only refuge, but the power supply is limited. You must carefully ration your energy, deciding which rooms to keep lit and which to let fall into darkness. Every flicker of light could mean the difference between safety and exposure. Run out of fuel, and you may not get another chance.

Sanity:

Windows keep opening… but did you forget to close them, or is something else inside with you? Keep them shut at all costs. If you let them stay open too long, you might see something you were never meant to. And whatever happens—do not look outside.

Fear:

Fear is more than a feeling—it’s an invitation. If you let the terror take hold, It will take notice. Things that shouldn’t be there begin to manifest. If you see them, make them disappear quickly. Do not stare. Do not hesitate. If you let them stay, you may not be able to tell what’s real anymore.

Story


A critical notice from the Bureau of Liberty and Individual Safety (B.L.I.S.)

Recent disturbances and abnormal phenomena have been detected in your area. For your safety and well-being, all individuals must remain inside their homes. Under no circumstances should you look outside. Keep all doors locked and windows shut.

DO NOT LOOK OUTSIDE. DO NOT GO OUTSIDE.

Some citizens have reported symptoms due to extended isolation, including:

  • Dry mouth

  • Blurred Vision

  • Irregular heart rhythm

  • Elevated blood pressure

  • Paranoia

  • Sightings of Angels

These symptoms are normal and will worsen if instructions are not followed.

To minimize these symptoms:

  • Keep a well-lit environment

  • Ensure all windows remain shut

  • Avoid visual contact with the outside

  • Avoid visual contact with the Angels

B.L.I.S. thanks you for your cooperation. Re-read this message carefully.

3552140.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
3552140.detailed_description:
Relive the golden ages of video rentals by opening your very own video store. Rent, sell, organize and build your business from the ground up. Hire staff, manage your team and become the best rental destination in town!

  

 

From taking reservations and charging late fees to recommending movies and preparing delicious snacks, there’s never a dull moment when running your store!

 

 

Customize your walls and floors, decorate with posters and memorabilia and expand your layout to build the video store of your dreams.

 

 

Fill your shelves with thousands of unique VHS tapes, each with their own title, genre and hand-drawn cover art! Order movies on your old PC or buy exclusive bootleg films from the shady Tape Dealer. Each week will have new releases inspired by real iconic movies of the 80s and early 90s.  

 

 

Additional Game Features:

  • Build Your Dream Team: Hire staff to give you a hand on daily tasks to run your store.

  • Manage Your Returns:  Add returned movies in the system, rewind tapes and set aside reserved movies for your customers.

  • Charge Late & Broken Fees: Track late and damaged returns and deal with different customer reactions and complaints.

  • Evolving Customer Interactions: Seasons, weather and holidays affect gameplay and what your customers rent! Be ready, rainy Friday nights are crazy busy in the store!

  • Seasons & Festivals: Play through all four seasons as the environment transforms around you. Each season features special holidays and festivals, all brought to life with unique artwork!

  • Share Movies With Your Friends: Every movie can be ordered on your PC with a unique code that you can share with your friends!

3558600.name: Leafy Corner
3558600.detailed_description:
Run the plant shop of your dreams in Leafy Corner, a cozy shop management game where you grow, sell, and care for real-life houseplants!

Step into the role of a plant shop owner. Grow plants, serve your customers, and create a warm, inviting space filled with greenery and charm.

Watch your plants grow over time, unfolding leaf by leaf as you care for them.

Not everyone knows what they’re looking for. Sometimes customers bring unusual or tricky requests. Finding just the right plant to fit their needs adds a fun challenge.

Decorate your shop with a variety of unlockable items, from shelves to plant pots. Pick colors that fit your mood and create a space that reflects your unique style.

KEY FEATURES

  • Grow, care for, and sell 100+ unique plants.

  • Discover plant variegations.

  • Build and decorate your shop with a variety of pots, furniture, and decoration options.

  • Fulfill orders and help customers.

  • Complete tasks to progress your shop.

  • Increase your shop’s reputation to unlock new content.

  • Customize your character.

What Leafy Corner does NOT offer:

  • Hardcore management (deep economy, hiring staff).

  • Advanced plant care.

  • Storyline.

We are working hard and pouring our hearts into making Leafy Corner. You can support us by wishlisting and following the game on Steam. And if you want to chat with us or fellow plant lovers, you can find us on Discord!

3582250.name: Farm to Table
3582250.detailed_description:
Farm to Table is a farming and restaurant management sim where you build a restaurant from scratch and grow food in the backyard. Explore a colourful island where you can grow and gather food, raise animals, go fishing, produce better food with machines and cook delicious recipes for your hungry guests! Build and customise your dream place, hire staff and grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant! 

Build From Scratch

Build your restaurant from scratch on a coastal hill overlooking a colorful island! Customize each corner of your kitchen and farm, indoors or outdoors. Choose from a wide variety of wall, flooring, window, decoration, and furniture styles.

Grow, Raise & Harvest

Grow fresh crops and raise animals right by your kitchen! Collect fresh produce and adopt pet companions. One harvest at a time!

Cook & Serve

Cook and Serve or Sell at your Farmers’ Market. Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island! Create diverse menus, cook, bake, grill and serve flavoursome dishes to raise your reputation and attract even more customers!

Gather & Fish

Gather all kinds of wild flavours like mushrooms, berries and much more or go fishing in the open seas for rare catches!

Produce

Get useful machines to turn harvest into more advanced ingredients and unlock new recipes.

Manage 

Manage resources, hire chefs, waiters and farmers, upgrade and grow the reputation of your place.Take it slow on the farm, then pick up the pace in the kitchen, turn your cozy humble spot into a 5-star restaurant!

3614130.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
3614130.detailed_description:
Shelves And Sorcery is a relaxing fantasy organization game about turning absolute chaos back into order.

Weapons, potions, spellbooks, fruits, vegetables, magical curiosities, and thousands of other items have been scattered throughout three fantasy shops. Pick everything up, find where it belongs, and slowly watch each shop return to the way it was meant to be.

Take your time and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything in its place, or learn every corner of the shop and race against players around the world for the fastest time.

Three Shops to Restore. Four Ways to Play.

Choose from three shops of dramatically different sizes, each with its own setting, atmosphere, and challenge. Then return to them in four different modes, whether you want to relax, chase the fastest time, wield every bit of magic from the start, or organize without magic at all.

• Casual Mode – No timer and no pressure. Take your time, enjoy the atmosphere, and organize every shelf at your own pace.

• Timed Mode – Race against the clock and compete on the global leaderboards. Learn where every item belongs, master your Sorceries and Enchantments, perfect your route, and keep pushing for a faster time.

• Archmage Mode – Start with every Sorcery and Enchantment already unlocked. Take on the entire shop at full magical strength and see just how powerful an experienced shopkeeper can be.

• No Magic Mode – The magic of the world has escaped. No Sorceries. No Enchantments. No magical shortcuts. Just you, thousands of misplaced items, and the knowledge you've gained along the way.

The Hearth & Barrel

1,000+ items to organize

A cozy shop tucked away in the quiet village of Burg. Once a welcoming stop for locals and passing adventurers, its shelves have fallen into disarray. With 1,048 items to restore, it's a comfortable introduction to the satisfying world of organizing.

The Merchant's Rest

3,000+ items to organize

A well-loved shop in the bustling market town of Stonebridge, built through years of honest work by its humble merchant. With 3,085 misplaced items, restoring The Merchant's Rest offers a much larger challenge with plenty of shelves waiting to be put right.

The Grand Athenaeum

4,000+ items to organize

High above the clouds on the floating isle of Vane stands a legendary shop filled with magical treasures from across the world. With 4,066 items scattered throughout, The Grand Athenaeum is the largest challenge of them all. Take your time restoring it, or master every shelf and chase the fastest time.

Sorcery Makes Everything Easier

Thankfully, you don't have to organize thousands of magical objects entirely by hand.

As you make progress, unlock Sorceries designed to help you tackle the mess.

Gather matching items from around the shop, reveal objects you've been struggling to find, or use magic to send items toward the shelves where they belong.

The more you organize, the more powerful your magical toolkit becomes.

Enchant Your Shopkeeper

Magic isn't limited to spells.

Unlock Enchantments that permanently improve your abilities and change how you move through each shop.

Carry more items at once. Increase your reach. Move faster. Jump higher. Eventually, even take to the air.

Combined with your Sorceries, these abilities can turn an experienced shopkeeper into an organizing force of nature and become an important part of chasing faster times.

Three Shops. Thousands of Items. One Place for Everything.

Whether you're carefully organizing The Hearth & Barrel after a long day, working your way through the thousands of items inside The Merchant's Rest, or fighting for a place on the leaderboard in The Grand Athenaeum, Shelves And Sorcery is built around one simple satisfaction:

Finding where something belongs...

and finally putting it there.

3615160.name: Teddy's Haven
3615160.detailed_description:
Welcome to Teddy’s Haven. 

Welcome to a cozy, magical shop simulator set on the enchanting island of Ursa. Run your store your way and sell what you harvest, craft, or discover. And enjoy the freedom to decorate freely across your shop, home, and the wilds beyond.

Level up naturally as you play, grow magical crops, and take part in daily events that bring the island to life. With over 250 decorations, 400 items to sell, and no pressure, every day is yours to enjoy at your own pace.

Ursa, A World of Calm and Wonder

Ursa is a gentle land filled with peace, memories, and mythical spirits. Your shop is a safe haven of supplies for travelers and magical beings alike. The land is rich and vibrant. You can harvest resources, care for its creatures, and meet friendly creatures along the way. In Ursa there is no conflict, only warmth and calm. This is your relaxing world to make your own.

Key Features:

  • Manage Your Magical Shop – Create the cozy shop you’ve always wanted. With changing seasons, daily surprises, and rewarding leveling systems, your shop grows alongside you. No rush, no stress, just a magical rhythm all your own.

  • Decorate Across Ursa – Over 250 decorations to decorate freely across your shop, home, and the island’s landscapes. With near-limitless placement freedom, express your style and bring every corner of Ursa to life.

  • A Wide Variety of Goods to Keep Your Shelves Full – Stock your shop with over 400 items gathered, grown, or traded across Ursa.

  • Skill Systems – Your skills grow naturally as you run your shop. Stock shelves faster, harvest more berries, and see your abilities improve with each task. Leveling up rewards you for doing what you love, at your own pace.

  • Crafting – Enjoy simple, stress-free crafting that doesn’t keep you waiting. Place your items and return the next day to find something special created. Always growing, crafting will expand with new features and more complex options in future updates.

  • Farming – Farming has arrived in the land of Ursa! Unlock new contracts that allow you to plant and nurture magical crops, each with unique Aether-infused variations. Grow, harvest, and fill your shop with wondrous goods born from the earth and touched by magic.

  • Unique and Magical Employees – Hire magical stockers and cashiers who keep your shop running smoothly. Whether you’re decorating, relaxing, or out exploring the world, they’ll reliably care for your haven as if it were their own.

  • Simplified Inventory Management – Too busy to sort through a warehouse of items? Open your “bag of everything” and stock shelves directly, hassle-free. Spend less time managing and more time enjoying your shop.

  • Exploration – Wander the ever-expanding world of Ursa at your own pace. Harvest berries, care for animals, or simply enjoy the beautiful scenery and discover the magic hidden in every corner.

  • Daily Events – Your shop is a hub of life and wonder. As the days pass, creatures will stop by with stories, gifts, or even magical blessings for your shop. Everyone you meet is here to help you grow and enjoy your cozy world.

  • Bounds Breaking Joy: Teddy’s Haven celebrates curiosity. And sometimes that means climbing too high, falling too far, or finding yourself under the map. Go ahead: break the bounds. Secret items and small surprises await those who wander a little too far from the intended path. It’s all part of the adventure.

  • Auto Saving – Take the game at your own pace, no more requirements of ending your day for your game to be saved.

  • Ongoing Development: Teddy’s Haven is in Early Access, with plans for new locations, minigames, world events, and more, the journey has only just begun.

Created In Loving Dedication To The Memory Of My Best Friend Teddy Bear.

3618030.name: Flock Around
3618030.detailed_description:
Flock Around is a co-op birdwatching game where you explore a nature sanctuary. Solo or with friends, snap pictures of funny birds, and fill out the park guide book!

Snap them all!

Goose Lake Sanctuary is home to numerous bird species, and if you can see it, you can take a picture of it. Fill out the guide book with pictures of each bird in its various poses, from the common Robin, to more rare and exotic birds. Explore a variety of biomes, perform actions and use items to lure in species, and mess with your friends!

Flock Together!

Flock Around is designed to be a shared social space where you and your friends can work together to get pictures of birds or each other! Birding is best with others, so you can play with up to 10 friends!

Customize your birder!

Collect cosmetics and make your birder unique, expressing your personality and eagle eyes to your friends. After taking your pictures, develop them for money to spend on outfits so you can go birding in style!

3693650.name: Thrifty Business
3693650.detailed_description:
There’s a brand new thrift store in town, and guess what? You’re in charge!

In Thrifty Business, you’ll set up and manage your very own 90’s-inspired vintage thrift shop. Search through boxes filled with pre-loved gems and use them to create gorgeous displays. Unlock furniture, decorations, wallpaper & floors to create a beautiful community space that brings everybody together!

Adjust your layout and organize your shelves and racks to the finest detail. Group your wares by colour, theme, purpose, or whatever you like. The more organized your store is, the more community points you’ll get to unlock new goodies!

Customize the furniture, wallpaper, flooring and decor to make your store as welcoming and cozy as possible. As business grows, you might even need to expand into the adjacent rooms!

This is so much more than just a store. Listen to customer’s stories and try to fulfill their requests. You can also unlock and host hobbyist events, turning your business into a treasured third space for locals!


🛍️ What Thrifty Business has in store for you:

  • laid-back management sim

  • colorful 90s-inspired graphics

  • 500+ different items to add to your shelves

  • precision placing so you can organize exactly how you want

  • customization options: furniture, decorations, wallpaper & flooring

  • a quirky and unique cast of customers

🙅‍♀️ What you won’t find on our shelves:

  • stressful min-maxing to get the best possible profit

  • setting item prices or haggling

  • impatient customers that leave your store in anger

3812600.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
3812600.detailed_description:
ReStory is a chill, narrative-driven shop management simulator from the creators of I Am Future, set on the bustling streets of mid-2000s Tokyo and featuring an in-depth device repair system. 

In this game, you run an electronics repair shop, meticulously restore nostalgic Y2K-era devices, including officially licensed Atari consoles, and interact with customers to experience a branching storyline with multiple endings that depend on your choices.

Greet customers, take their devices in for repairs, manage your finances, and surf the web for spare parts. Relax and enjoy running your own small shop in a game created with love and respect for the one-of-a-kind vibe of the Japanese urban life in the mid-2000s.

Fix a variety of nostalgic devices inspired by iconic game consoles, handhelds, phones, cameras, music players, and home appliances. Carefully take each gadget apart, clean it, replace faulty parts, and assemble it back together using your trusty toolset.

The way you interact with each customer can change their lives forever. Will you report on a disturbing find inside the former gangster’s phone, or help a lovestruck student confess to his crush? Make your own choices and see how they impact the branching storyline.

Key Features

  • Relaxing electronics repair shop management

  • A wide range of nostalgic 2000s devices to repair

  • In-depth device cleaning and restoration system

  • Y2K-era web browser to hunt for spare parts

  • A variety of in-person and online orders to fulfill

  • Multiple tools for device repairs

  • Iconic Atari consoles, officially licensed for the game

  • Customers with unique stories and dialogues

  • Replayable branching storyline with choices impacting the ending

  • A distinct, chill vibe of urban life in Japan

3938640.name: Ugoku Sushi Bar
3938640.detailed_description:
Menu Reveal ✨ Wishlist Now!


About the Game

🍣 Welcome to Ugoku Sushi Bar, where conveyor belts, cozy vibes, and culinary creativity collide! 🍵

You’ve just taken over a small sushi bar tucked away in a charming Japanese town. With a humble kitchen and a head full of dreams, it’s up to you to turn your little eatery into the talk of the town.



As the conveyor belt keeps moving, so does your journey. Slice, roll, and plate an ever-growing variety of delicious Japanese dishes, serve hungry customers, discover over 100 sushi recipes, and experiment with a Minecraft-style crafting system to create new sushi combinations.



  • 🎏 Prepare and Plate: Craft everything from classic sushi to creative Japanese side dishes. Timing, accuracy, and presentation matter!
  • 🍥 Conveyor Belt Chaos: Fulfill orders by placing them on the belt at the right time and in the right order, or face some seriously confused customers.
  • 😺 Quirky Regulars: Meet an eclectic cast of recurring customers, each with unique tastes, stories, and personalities. Some just want sushi, others want a chat.
  • 📚 Learn & Master Recipes: Unlock new recipes as you progress, from simple nigiri to specialty rolls and surprise seasonal dishes.
  • 🛠️ Upgrade Your Kitchen: Invest in new tools, appliances, and ingredients to boost your efficiency and expand your menu.


  • 🌸 Cozy Atmosphere: A warm, relaxing art style paired with ambient sounds and music makes every shift feel satisfying and peaceful.
  • 📈 Story & Progression: As your sushi bar grows, you’ll uncover the backgrounds of your customers, unlock new décor, and even participate in local events and food festivals.
  • 🐟 Fresh Ingredients, Fresh Challenges: Seasonal fish, special requests, and daily challenges keep you on your toes while keeping things fun.


Ugoku Sushi Bar is a cozy job simulator full of flavor, charm, and heart. Whether you're a sushi enthusiast, a fan of relaxing sim games, or just love a well-told story in a small package, this game invites you to slow down, serve up joy, and savor the little victories.

Slice. Serve. Smile. Your sushi journey starts here.

3948120.name: Scritchy Scratchy
3948120.detailed_description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:

• Boosted odds and payouts

• Faster and easier scratching 

• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!

4025700.name: Heartopia
4025700.detailed_description:
Welcome to Heartopia, a multiplayer life simulation game crafted for creativity, freedom, and peace. Build your dream home, explore a wide range of hobbies, and forge warm connections with friends in a town full of endless possibilities.

[Game Features]
◆ Let's Connect! Create Unique Memories
Chat with the charming residents of Heartopia Town, hang out with old friends, and meet new friends every time you log in!

◆ Let's Explore! Gardening, Fishing, Birding...
Hobbies are yours to enjoy, not chores. In Heartopia, feel free to develop six major hobbies, including fishing, cooking, gardening, birdwatching, and more.

◆ Let's Build! Design Your Dream House
Whether you dream of a cozy cottage or a magnificent mansion, Heartopia gives you the tools to turn your vision into a reality. You can also invite your friends over and build your dream home together.

◆ Let's Dress Up! 1000+ Daily Outfits
Mix and match casual wear, elegant gowns, and whimsical costumes to create the perfect look for any occasion. Express your mood and show the world who you are.


◆ Let's Pet! Adopt Cats and Dogs
Meet your very own animal companions in Heartopia! While each of your furry friends may come with different colors and personalities, they can all bring you warmth and comfort.

4026250.name: Project P.I.T.T.
4026250.detailed_description:
You are a new intern at a company with a very simple task. Craft rubber ducks and feed them to the pit.

At the center of the facility waits the Maw – a vast corporate hole with an appetite that only grows larger the more you feed it. Make ducks, throw them in, earn your place.

The company is watching. The pit is growing. Ducks will not be enough.

Unlock new tools, produce stranger objects, improve your workflow, and build increasingly chaotic physics-based systems to keep up with demand. With each phase, the Maw expands, the facility shifts, and your responsibilities become harder to explain.

Eventually, simple production turns into assembly. Objects begin to connect in unexpected ways. Your work stops feeling like a job. Where are you? Who’s your employer? Why are you doing all this?

FEATURES

  • Build absurd physics-based production lines and feed products to the Maw

  • Start with rubber ducks, then unlock stranger products, tools, and automation systems

  • Use magnets, fans, panels, pistons, launchers, and more to optimize production

  • Chain combos and improve throughput for higher payouts

  • Watch the Maw grow larger as production escalates

  • Explore a brutalist PSX-style corporate facility

4078200.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
4078200.detailed_description:
Dwarf Eats Mountain is a strategic incremental game about devouring mountains for gold. Hire dwarves, deploy war machines, and collect powerful artifacts to build absurd synergies and grow faster each run.

Hurting the mountain physically (and emotionally) is only half the battle—you still have to safely haul the gold home. That perilous job falls to the Runners, who weave through falling rocks, risking their beards to feed the Great Maw!

But beware—the Great Mother won’t give up her treasure easily. The more damage your greedy dwarves deal to the mountain, the more calamities it unleashes upon the wobbling beards below!

Balance mining with hauling your gold home—before the sky falls on your head.

Master the dwarven ways of treasure extraction!
This game is about making numbers go up, but the way you do that is open to your interpretation and ingenuity. At your fingertips:

  • Many buildings and dwarves, each with various strengths and weaknesses, such as dynamite throwers, ballistas, flamers, laser cannons, spelunkers, runesmiths, brewmasters, bulldozers, gyrocopters and more!

4120790.name: The Sorting Bureau
4120790.detailed_description:
Every Item Has Its Place

A desk covered in someone's life. Vintage buttons, foreign coins, delicate stamps, old gears, and forgotten sweets. Pick up each item and find where it belongs.

Every Material Has Its Sound

Metal clinks. Fabric rustles. Wood thuds. Each item snaps into its container with a satisfying click. The kind of sound you want to hear over and over.

Stories Told Through Objects

Every request comes from someone real. A watchmaker and his gears. A pastry chef and her molds. A manga artist buried in brushes and sketches. They bring their boxes and ask for help. Sort through their things and piece together their stories.

Your Evening Ritual

New boxes show up every morning. New clients, new items, new sorting rules. Your quiet evening never runs out.

Features

  • Sort hundreds of tactile items across dozens of themed desks
  • No timers, no penalties, no scores. Play at your own pace
  • ASMR sound design: every material sounds different
  • Charming clients, each with their own personality and story
  • Endless requests. There's always another desk waiting
  • A cozy workshop tucked away in a quiet Tokyo neighborhood

4197610.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
4197610.detailed_description:
【Synopsis】

A mischievous fairy has left the once-majestic library in utter chaos. The principal’s word is law: "You are forbidden from leaving until all 3,072 books are returned to their rightful places!" In the silent, mystical archive, your long battle against the mountain of books begins.

【Gameplay: Library Organization Simulator】This is a first-person organization simulator set in a magical library

  • Categorization: From Destructive Magic and The Travels of Otherworld to Romance Novels—use titles and cover designs as clues to transport a massive collection to the correct sections.

  • Massive Volume: With 3,072 books to organize, the task may seem overwhelming at first. However, as you stack each book, you will unlock magical abilities that drastically boost your efficiency.

【Key Features】

  • Visual Satisfaction: There is a special joy in seeing the books that once cluttered the floor return to the shelves, slowly revealing the hidden floor beneath. As chaos transforms into perfect order, you’ll experience an unparalleled sense of satisfaction.

  • Strategic Efficiency: How will you combine your unlocked abilities? What order will you tackle the mess? The strategic fun lies in your decision-making, as your tactics can lead to a dramatic increase in workflow.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: The library’s ambient sound and BGM change dynamically; as shelves fill up, the acoustic resonance grows stronger, drawing you deeper into the world.

  • The Principal’s Strict Evaluation: Your precision is being monitored. The Principal’s evaluation shifts in real-time based on how many rows are "correctly shelved" according to the rules. Accuracy and speed are the keys to a perfect score—and your escape.

【Efficiency via Magical Abilities】 As you progress, you can unlock powerful magical abilities to aid your work

  • Assemble: A spell that summons other volumes of the same series directly to your hands.

  • Insight: Highlights other volumes of the same series, making them easy to spot even in a disorganized pile.

  • Auto-Shelving: A spell that instantly places the books in your hands onto the shelves in perfect order.

A fun, laid-back game

No one will rush you, or watch your every step, or criticize your actions. You can meditatively sift through garbage looking for interesting things... or just run around with a trash bag! Your dump site, your rules!

Upgrade yourself to become better, faster, stronger, and more efficient at clearing tons of garbage. Turn yourself into a veritable trash-mowing machine!

4315040.name: Hearth and Hamlet
4315040.detailed_description:
From Campfire to Kingdom. Citybuilder Clicker.

Hearth and Hamlet is a cozy incremental citybuilder set in a magic-filled medieval pixel art world. Gather resources, assign workers, construct buildings and slowly, steadily turn a quiet frontier camp into a magnificent, thriving kingdom.

From humble beginnings to magical new heights, you’ll grow your settlement one decision at a time and discover more of what the world has to offer along the way.

RUN YOUR KINGDOM YOUR WAY

Building is only the beginning. As your settlement grows, managing it becomes just as important as expanding it. Set laws and policies to shape how your kingdom operates, including taxation rules to boost income, rules for workers that keep morale high, city guard drafts to protect your population and civic decisions that change the character of your kingdom.

Every upgrade feeds into a research tree that permanently unlocks new technologies, from more advanced buildings and new policies, to stronger magic to experiment with. There’s always something worth working toward.

EXPLORE MAGIC AND TRADE WITH FARAWAY LANDS

Unlock magic as your city advances and discover wild new possibilities, such as alchemical labs and magical academies that add a whole new dimension to how your kingdom operates. 

Trade with strange new lands to build resources and grow your economy. Recruit soldiers as your realm expands to protect what you’ve built. There’s a world of wonder to discover as your empire grows.

FEATURES 

  • Incremental idle kingdom builder. A cozy, satisfying gameplay loop that rewards patience and planning..

  • Medieval pixel art world. Lakes and rivers, magical swamps, faraway lands, and more. All rendered in a charming pixel style.

  • Deep building system. From simple tents to taverns, castles, magical academies, defensive fortifications, and much more.

  • Manage resources, workers and policies. Assign your population to gather resources like food, wood, stone and gold. Set policies and laws that shape how your kingdom grows.

  • Research new technologies. Permanently unlock new buildings, magic and upgrades as your civilization advances. Discover magic, alchemy and more.

  • Trade with faraway lands. Grow your economy beyond what your local terrain provides by establishing trade routes with neighbouring kingdoms.

  • Relax, build and grow. Gameplay is engineered to be relaxing and satisfying. Watch your kingdom grow on your terms, at your pace.

4380490.name: Cat Mail Co.
4380490.detailed_description:
A quiet island. A forgotten post office. And a mountain of undelivered mail.

You arrive just in time… or perhaps a little too late. The former postman has vanished, leaving chaos behind: parcels piled to the ceiling, customers growing impatient, and a once-thriving postal service on the brink of collapse.

One package at a time, you’ll bring it back to life.

Cat Mail Co. is about slowing down and enjoying the rhythm of small, satisfying tasks.

Incoming mail arrives by boat, and outgoing parcels must be carefully loaded for their journey.

Sort deliveries for the right destinations, or risk having them returned damaged. Take your time serving customers, organize your storage exactly the way you like, prepare for the next wave, and keep everything running smoothly as the post office slowly regains its former glory.

With each improvement, new destinations unlock, along with tools and abilities to help you manage the growing operation.

Every package tells you how it wants to be handled… but how you do it is up to you.

Weigh parcels to determine postage, apply destination labels, mark fragile or heavy goods, and decorate them with a variety of stamps. Functional or whimsical, every sticker you place adds personality to your work.

There’s no such thing as a “correct” way but just your way.

The post office doesn’t sleep… and neither do you.

As night settles in, moonlight reveals secrets. What seemed ordinary during the day may carry strange properties after dark, offering magical insight into how some parcels should be treated.

The routine continues, but in a magical way.

The massive backlog left behind isn’t just a task, it’s the story of the post office waiting to be uncovered.

Run the post office solo, or with friends.

With up to 4-player co-op, you can divide tasks, optimize your workflow, or simply enjoy the routine together. Whether you’re stamping, sorting, or loading the boat, teamwork makes the mail flow.

Cat Mail Co. Features

  • A cozy, stress-free gameplay loop with no timers or penalties

  • A satisfying package handling system: weigh, stamp, label, and sort

  • A meaningful day/night cycle with magical nighttime mechanics

  • A relaxing “pre-crastination” experience focused on preparation and flow

  • A post office in a cat's world to organize and restore

  • Up to 4-player cooperative gameplay

  • A narrative discovered through sorting parcels

Weigh parcels to determine postage, apply destination labels, mark fragile or heavy goods, and decorate them with a variety of stamps. Functional or whimsical, every sticker you place adds personality to your work.

There’s no such thing as a “correct” way but just your way.

The post office doesn’t sleep… and neither do you.

As night settles in, moonlight reveals secrets. What seemed ordinary during the day may carry strange properties after dark, offering magical insight into how some parcels should be treated.

The routine continues, but in a magical way.

The massive backlog left behind isn’t just a task, it’s the story of the post office waiting to be uncovered.

Run the post office solo, or with friends.

With up to 4-player co-op, you can divide tasks, optimize your workflow, or simply enjoy the routine together. Whether you’re stamping, sorting, or loading the boat, teamwork makes the mail flow.

Cat Mail Co. Features

  • A cozy, stress-free gameplay loop with no timers or penalties

  • A satisfying package handling system: weigh, stamp, label, and sort

  • A meaningful day/night cycle with magical nighttime mechanics

  • A relaxing “pre-crastination” experience focused on preparation and flow

  • A post office in a cat's world to organize and restore

  • Up to 4-player cooperative gameplay

  • A narrative discovered through sorting parcels

Bills Must Be Paid is an active incremental game about paying your bills by smashing piggy banks.

Smash Piggy Banks

Smashing costs stamina. When your hand is getting tired the run is over.

Different piggy types

New types to discover. Some run away, some are too lazy to move, and others carry all the black money you never had :P...

Random loot

Piggies spawn random loot

Upgrades

A skill tree with multiple paths. Improve your grip strength, get addicted to caffeine, hit the gym, pump up your wrist, get more lucky, unlock abilities like rock rain, electrify your hammer, and more.

Different Hammers

Unlock different types of hammer. Some have higher crit chance and smaller radius, while others are super fast with big radius and less damage. Choose the one that better fits your own playstyle.

Collect rare coins

4927490.name: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery
4927490.detailed_description:
Synopsis

 When's the worst time to be the janitor of a puzzle gallery? After an earthquake, of course! You play as the janitor of a puzzle gallery, and an earthquake has scattered all of the 2000+ pieces everywhere. Your job is to use your puzzling skills (and some added enhancements) to put all of the pieces back in their place.

The Ultimate Challenge or the Coziest Simulator

Listen to classical music and admire famous paintings as you solve 87 jigsaw puzzles of varying shapes, subjects, and sizes. Whether you want to see how fast you can solve every one by min-maxing various abilities and sprinting across the gallery, or you just want to chill and work on some puzzles, this clean up simulator is right for you.

A Gallery Of Masterpieces...

The gallery is home to 87 paintings from 13 famous artists such as Monet, Van Gogh, Hokusai, and more, ensuring each piece and section is visually unique and distinctive from the others. Each of the paintings was sourced from Public Domain scans and photographs of their museum originals.

... Or Curated by YOU

Upload your images and turn them into puzzles! You can solve them one at a time and adjust their size, or fill the entire gallery with your own curated selection in the My Puzzles game mode, providing you with full customization and endless gameplay.

Key Features

  • Intuitive controls and visuals such as ghost previews on hover and shimmering piece lock-in effects make the act of solving a puzzle both satisfying and exciting.

  • Skill upgrades to different areas of your brain that help you find, manipulate, and solve puzzles quicker with each puzzle you complete.

  • Challenge Modes for those puzzlers that don't need any extra assistance, or are looking for different challenges to make the game feel totally different such as a Black & White Mode and "The Big White" (1024 pieces of pure white).

  • Turn any image you want into puzzles of varying shapes and sizes so that, whether you want to create a greater challenge with a 1000 piece landscape, or just turn your pet into a 50 piece easy solve, you can solve as many puzzles as you want!

  • Want to curate your own gallery? You can upload up to 83 images and fill the gallery with memes, custom artwork, or really anything (so long as it's a png or jpg).

4928820.name: Shelve the Potions!
4928820.detailed_description:
Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

The witch had to leave on urgent business. By the time you arrive for your very first day as her apprentice. Her mischievous cats have knocked every potion off the shelves, turning the workshop into complete chaos. To leave a good first impression, we might as well put them back up.

Gameplay

Each shelf is its own handcrafted puzzle with unique rules waiting to be discovered. Sort and organize over 2,000+ potions, learning how every order works through experimentation, logic, and observation.

Some puzzles can be solved at a glance, while others require finding hidden clues, using special items, or connecting information you've learned elsewhere in the workshop.

Whenever you feel stuck, Pet the magical cats, then ask them for hints. They'll point you toward missing potions, highlight important clues, or even reveal part of a puzzle's solution when you need a little extra help.

Features

  • 20+ handcrafted potion-sorting puzzles with unique rules to discover.

  • Organize and sort 2,000+ unique potions throughout the workshop.

  • Relaxing gameplay with no timers or penalties.

  • Cozy fantasy atmosphere inspired by witches, and alchemy.

  • Cute cats!

4934370.name: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
4934370.detailed_description:
This is a first-person organization simulation game where you shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive.

Game Modes

Solo, together, or competition...

Enjoy the different game modes: Single player, online co-op, and online PvP.

You can also try "Sandbox Mode", where all your skills are unlocked and always ready to use, or "No-Skill Mode" to challenge yourself.

Videotape Categories

Your task is to shelve 3,180 videotapes into the correct categories in the archive.

Action movies, drama movies, TV series, cartoons, horror movies, comedy movies, athletic games, football cups, romance movies, sci-fi movies, baseball, tennis, news, game shows, basketball, motorsport, cooking shows, documentaries, boxing, and talk shows.

Skills

  • Sorting Numerically: Sorts the videotapes in your hand in numerical order

  • Highlighting Shelf: Highlights the correct shelf for the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Highlighting Videotapes: Highlights the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

  • Auto-Placement: Automatically places your videotapes on the shelf in the correct order

  • Auto-Collect: Automatically collects the same videotapes as the topmost videotape in your hand

4935510.detailed_description:
【A Cozy Cellar Organization Simulator】

A once-pristine cellar has fallen into complete disarray.

Return 2,448 bottles to their proper racks by identifying their varieties and restoring perfect order throughout the cellar.

 【The Forgotten Keeper】

Long ago, the cellar belonged to an eccentric collector who loved his bottle collection more than anything else.

Desperate to preserve it forever, he attempted an ancient spell. The cellar survived... but the spell turned him into a chicken and trapped him inside a small cage.

Now the cellar has fallen into ruin.

Restore every rack, break the curse, and help the forgotten keeper see the sunlight once again.

【Restore Order, One Rack at a Time】

The cellar starts in complete chaos.

As you organize each rack, the room gradually transforms into a clean, beautiful collection.

Watching disorder disappear is its own reward.

【Learn Skills to Organize Faster】

Unlock powerful abilities that improve carrying, searching, and movement.

Choose your upgrades wisely and discover the most efficient way to organize the cellar.

 Cozy Mode

- Relaxing gameplay

- Unlock skills

- No time limits

- Organize at your own pace

- No skill upgrades

- Pure efficiency

- Compete on the online leaderboard

- Every second matters

- Organize 2,448 bottles

- Unlock powerful skills

- Restore a forgotten cellar

- Relaxing gameplay with no time limits

- Dedicated Speedrun Mode

- Online Leaderboards

- Atmospheric underground environment

4950470.name: Tidy Up Together
4950470.detailed_description:
NO AI WAS USED IN THE MAKING OF THIS GAME

Tidy Up Together is a cozy organizing simulator about restoring your fantasy Adventurer's shop. An evil wizard has blasted thousands of your products all over the floor - and it's your job to put them back!

Shop Restoration

Item by item you'll build the shop back to its former tidiness. There's an incredible range of products ranging from potions to sushi. Those Greatswords really shouldn't be mixing with the pineapples...

Multiplayer

It's a mighty big puzzle to solve. Maybe some friends could help you out?

Don't worry if you'd prefer to tidy at your own pace; the game is also perfect in single player!

Abilities

That wizard isn't the only one who knows some magic. As you tidy you'll be inspired to learn new abilities to help maximise your efficiency.

Key Features

  • Multiplayer - Invite as many friends as you like to help you out.

  • Character Customization with multiple outfits.

  • 3 Levels of varying sizes.

  • Full Controller support.

  • 650, 2500 and almost 10,000 items across 14 categories and three shops.

  • Ability upgrades.

  • No time limits (but you can see completion time at the end) and no game over. Tidy Up at your own pace!
